title: Boats and the Sea of Galilee
summary: Boats were part of travel, fishing, teaching, and storms around the Sea of Galilee.
background: The Sea of Galilee formed the setting for several miracles and teaching moments. Sudden storms, fishing labor, and shoreline crowds give concrete shape to the Gospel narratives.
teachingHelp: Boat scenes often reveal Christ’s authority over creation and His call to trust Him in fear.
